title: Balanced Vego Nachos
subtitle: with Sweet Potato 'Chips' and Guacamole
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled sweet potatoes into 1cm-thick rounds. Finely chop the tomatoes. Drain and rinse the beans.

Bake sweet potato: Put the sweet potato on the lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil and scatter over half the Tex-Mex seasoning. Season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Bake, turning halfway, for 20-25 mins until golden and tender.
Make tomato salsa: Meanwhile, combine the tomato and 2 tsp red wine vinegar in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.

Bake nachos: Put the beans, remaining Tex-Mex seasoning and 2 tsp olive oil in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Spoon the beans and half the tomato salsa over the sweet potato, then scatter over the cheese. Bake for 8 mins or until warmed through and the cheese is melted.

Serve up: Cut the lime into wedges. Top the nachos with the guacamole and remaining tomato salsa. Divide among bowls or pop the tray on the table for everyone to help themselves. Serve with the lime wedges for squeezing over. Enjoy!
Make it herby: If you have some on hand, scatter over a handful of coriander leaves for a burst of freshness.
